## Notation quick reference {#sec-notation .unnumbered}

This project maintains a full, growing symbol table across all eight
workbooks. The three tables below cover every symbol Chapters 1-8
actually use, grouped roughly by where each symbol first appears --
flip back here if a symbol in an equation isn't immediately obvious.

| Symbol | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| $B$ | batch size | number of independent sequences processed together |
| $S$ | sequence length | number of tokens retained in the KV-cache |
| $T_q$ | query positions (current step) | number of new positions a step computes queries for ($T_q = S$ during prefill, $T_q = 1$ for an ordinary decode step) |
| $V$ | vocabulary size | number of distinct token ids; also the output-head's logit width |
| $d_{\text{model}}$ | hidden dimension | width of the residual stream, constant across every block |
| $H_q$ | query heads | number of attention query heads |
| $H_{kv}$ | key/value heads | number of attention key/value heads ($H_{kv} = H_q$ for MHA, $H_{kv} = 1$ for MQA, $1 < H_{kv} < H_q$ for GQA) |
| $d_{\text{head}}$ | head dimension | width of one attention head, $d_{\text{model}} / H_q$ |

: Notation, part 1 of 3 -- sequence, batch, and attention-head symbols (ch. 1-3) {#tbl-notation-1}

| Symbol | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| $L$ | number of layers | count of decoder blocks stacked |
| $d_{\text{ff}}$ | feed-forward expansion dimension | width of a feed-forward sublayer's hidden projection |
| $\text{bytes\_per\_elem}$ | bytes per cached element | storage width of one stored number (e.g. 2 for bf16); stated explicitly per calculation, never assumed |
| $d_c$ | MLA KV compression dimension | width of MLA's shared, jointly-compressed latent for keys and values (one per token per layer, not one per head) |
| $d_{\text{rope}}$ | MLA decoupled rotary dimension | per-head width of MLA's separately-retained rotary component, cached alongside the compressed latent |
| $M_{KV}$ | KV-cache size (MHA/MQA/GQA) | logical, theoretical-minimum cache bytes for one sequence under standard head-sharing attention (ch. 3's cache-size equation) |
| $M_{\text{MLA}}$ | MLA cache size | logical, theoretical-minimum cache bytes for one sequence under MLA's compressed latent (ch. 4's cache-size equation) |
| $W$ | sliding-window width | number of positions a windowed attention layer directly attends to; stacked layers reach $L \times W$ indirectly |
| $E$ | routed expert count | number of routed experts in a mixture-of-experts layer |
| $k$ | selected experts per token | number of routed experts a router activates per token (top-$k$) |

: Notation, part 2 of 3 -- cache, MLA, and mixture-of-experts symbols (ch. 3-5) {#tbl-notation-2}

| Symbol | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| $p_e$ | parameters per routed expert | parameter count of one routed expert (assumed equal-sized) |
| $p_s$ | shared-expert parameters | parameter count of an always-active shared-expert path (0 if none) |
| $p_{\text{base}}$ | non-expert (base) parameters | everything outside the routed bank and shared expert -- attention, embeddings, norms, router; always active |
| $P_{\text{total}}$ | total parameters | every parameter in the model, active or not |
| $P_{\text{active}}$ | active parameters | parameters touched in the forward pass for one token ($P_{\text{active}} = P_{\text{total}}$ for dense models) |
| $L_{\text{distinct}}$ | distinct transformer blocks | number of different sets of block weights actually stored |
| $T_{\text{passes}}$ | passes through the shared block/stack | how many times a looped architecture applies its blocks to the evolving hidden state |
| $L_{\text{effective}}$ | effective block applications | $L_{\text{effective}} = L_{\text{distinct}} \times T_{\text{passes}}$ -- governs compute, not distinct-parameter storage |

: Notation, part 3 of 3 -- parameter-count and looped-depth symbols (ch. 5-8) {#tbl-notation-3}
